site.label: WATCH IT WORK
site.title: One minute with OFF42.
site.text: Keep writing a Word letter, check a budget, present a deck, fix a PDF and scan a page — then turn a product list into QR labels with CE marks. Every frame is rendered by the apps themselves on a Mac, with sample documents of fictional companies.
site.caption: Silent demo, about a minute. Real app renders; camera moves and the pointer are added.

captions.introLine: Opens Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files  ·  Works offline  ·  Free and open source
captions.docTitle: Open a Word file and keep writing.
captions.docSub: Opens DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF and Markdown · saves DOCX, ODT, RTF and PDF.
captions.xlsTitle: Spreadsheets with real formulas and charts.
captions.xlsSub: XLSX, XLS, ODS and CSV · 384 functions · charts.
captions.pptSub: Presenter view with the next slide, notes and a timer · export to PDF or video.
captions.pdfEditTitle: Fix a typo right inside the PDF.

captions.compressTitle: Shrink a heavy PDF before you email it.
